label: NEW UNFILTERED SYNTHETIC COHORT; NO PHYSICAL ROBOT

protocol.seedRule: Exactly baseSeed+1 through baseSeed+count, no refill or outcome-based skipping.
protocol.generator: Row-major Bernoulli draws using uint32 LCG state=1664525*state+1013904223 modulo2^32, draw=state/2^32. Skip draws at the two point endpoint cells only. Do not clear neighboring walls or choose endpoints after seeing results.
protocol.inclusion: All30 generated maps retained. No reachability/endpoint-clearance filter, rejection replacement or acceptance quota. Exact endpoint cells free by construction, body-invalid endpoint cases remain in denominator.
protocol.controls: Same original map/endpoints/body/margin/contact convention within each policy pair. Core/disk/policy unchanged from prior86-test control; new acquisition/reference/analysis layer only. Fine graph17x13 and coarse9x7; coarse100 exceeds all63 candidate nodes, so coarse budget failure cannot occur here. Fine100 may stop before exhaustive search.
protocol.budgetScope: 100 per stage, policy caps100 direct versus200 staged. Preserve this historical policy definition; do not claim equal-total-budget success comparison.
protocol.references: Build both sample graphs and independently audit all candidate centers against original unit-square geometry; run separate unbudgeted BFS only when both chosen endpoints have clearance. Invalid endpoints have null graph reachability and no BFS call. BFS references label outcomes after generation and never filter inputs.
protocol.outcomes: ROUTE_FOUND, BUDGET_EXCEEDED, UNREACHABLE on the chosen sample graph, INVALID_ENDPOINT_CLEARANCE. Keep every raw stage/outcome, paths/masks, full actual examined work and zero-planner invalid-endpoint cases. Fine-graph reachability is not continuous physical impossibility.
protocol.metrics: All30 status counts/success rates and total examined work, endpoint-valid subset count/work separately, success-length means with actual denominators, matched jointly successful path-length comparison and fine-BFS labels. Never compare route-length means as paired if success cohorts differ; never treat cheap failure as efficiency improvement.
protocol.attribution: Student selects offered inclusion of failures, no rationale or outcome forecast. AI supplies exact count/seed/density/generator/analysis/validation, operates code and writes initial interpretation.
protocol.scope: A new synthetic unfiltered fixed-seed condition frozen before generation, not a measured workload, proof of statistical independence, universal policy benefit, continuous-motion completeness, time/energy/storage or physical-robot measurement. Do not revise protocol or sample range based on outcomes.
